An '''infant''' [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] born into [[House of Thul|House Thul]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great Houses]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], was used as part of a plot by House Thul to attain power. Unable to marry a Thul into the current royal family, House Thul switched their infant with a [[Unidentified Organa infant|baby]] from [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]; when the child grew up, House Thul supported the changeling as a potential bride for the [[Unidentified crown prince|crown prince]]<ref name="Codex" /> around [[3703 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|An Iron Fist|Alderaan}} indicates that [[House of Thul|House Thul]] was exiled sixty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', placing their exile around [[3703 BBY]].</ref> However, a [[Unidentified Jedi (Thul scandal)|young Jedi]] exposed the deception and stopped the [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]]. The resultant scandal saw the entire House Thul [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from Alderaan.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thul infant was first mentioned in the Codex entry for House Thul in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
